issues.description: Two getter methods are declared with private visibility in the solution but the exercise and template ask students to "Implement getters for each attribute" (which implies public access and is what the tests expect). Specifically, in solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java the methods getLectureName() (line 22) and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() (line 30) are declared private, while the problem statement requests public getters and the template contains a TODO to add getters (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java TODO for 2.1/2.2). This mismatch can cause student code/tests that assume public getters to fail or be unclear about the intended visibility.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the getters for all Lecture attributes public in the solution (change getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() to public). Also ensure the template and problem statement clearly state that getters should be public so students and automated tests have a consistent expectation.
